programs.title: Savage Kingdom
programs.desc: Nothing will stop ruthless predators on their way to their prey.Their survival depends on large herds of animals that have been coming to the same place year after year for millennia to quench their thirst.Lions, leopards and hyenas know perfectly well that they will not survive if they do not engage in a fierce fight to the death.The creators of the series will show this fight from a different perspective.They will present the brutal world of animals from both the predator and the prey perspective.Viewers will witness a bloody struggle for power against the background of beautiful African landscapes.They will learn the motives behind every move of the fighters and see that it is a world where no one stays on top forever, and only the strongest survive.

programs.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programs.desc: The creators of the program present the wildest parts of South America and the creatures inhabiting them that had to adapt to difficult conditions.These animals are peculiar and surprising.

programs.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programs.desc: Traveler and filmmaker Bertie Gregory journeys to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: the island of South Georgia in Antarctica and the frigid North Canada in the Arctic.You will see how the animals that inhabit these harsh areas cope and how global warming affects their habitats.You will see scenes from the lives of king and golden-crested penguins, sea lions, southern whales and petrels, as well as polar bears and wolves.Surviving in these extremely different environments requires cunning and perseverance.
